oldEvidence.quote: Before your Restaurant begins operations, you must procure and install, at your expense, the computer system and POS system that A&W requires at that time, the combined cost of which ranges from approximately $15,100 to $45,100.

The computer system will consist of the computer hardware, software, systems (e.g., restaurant management system), digital platforms (e.g., digital learning platform), wired and/or wireless internet connections and service, required dedicated telephone and power lines and other computer-related accessories, peripherals and equipment that A&W then specifies.
A&W estimates that on average the cost of maintenance, upgrading and support for your computer and POS systems will range, approximately, between $1,870 – 9,620 annually.

Prior to attending the Management Training Course, each of your attendees must attend and complete Food Safety Training. Your attendees may attend Food Safety Training at a location of your choice (provided that the training complies with our requirements) or through our online module at a cost of $100 per person.
A&W is currently providing the Management Training Course for up to 3 trainees free of cost but will charge $200 per day for each additional trainee you would like to attend.
